purpose: Default visual identity for generated artifacts when no user or supplied artifact identity is present.

layout.tone: restrained, clear hierarchy, generous whitespace, and accessible contrast

logo.rule: Use only a supplied or runtime-packaged Chainabit mark; do not fabricate, download, or stamp a logo into user-authored content.

ownership.informationExpert: this profile owns distributed artifact-default values and precedence semantics
ownership.controller: the composed artifact skill resolves the request into its format-specific spec before invoking a renderer
ownership.creator: the format renderer creates its concrete theme from the resolved spec
ownership.staticAssets: the publishing runtime owns website shell metadata and browser assets, not generated content
